chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurarah, who said:
I asked Abā Ja'far عليه السلام about tayammum, so he struck the ground with his two hands, then raised them and shook them off, then wiped with them his forehead and his two palms one single time.

key_terms.بِيَدَيْهِ: with his two hands, indicating the limbs used to begin tayammum
key_terms.جَبْهَتَهُ: his forehead, the first area wiped in the described method
key_terms.كَفَّيْهِ: his two palms, the hands wiped in tayammum
key_terms.مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً: one single time, indicating the number of wipes mentioned in this report
key_terms.ٱلتَّيَمُّمِ: dry ablution performed with earth or ground in place of wudu (ablution)
key_terms.ٱلْأَرْضَ: the ground or earth, the surface used for tayammum

ai.seo_question: How is tayammum performed according to the hadith of Abā Ja'far عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the manner of tayammum as demonstrated by Abā Ja'far عليه السلام. It shows that tayammum is performed by striking the earth with both hands, shaking them off, and then wiping the forehead and palms once.
